reason: My helper does part of the cooking and I just order from Talabat or Breadfast when I need something, I don't plan or track what's in the fridge. Scanning receipts and logging food sounds like homework I'd drop in a week.
objection: The kitchen is run by my helper and my mother, not by an app, and I don't plan ahead anyway. Why would I pay every month to log groceries I order on my phone in two taps?
would_change_my_mind: If it connected straight to my Talabat/Noon/Breadfast orders so the kitchen fills itself with no receipt scanning, and my helper could use it in Arabic.
